title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story 4 December 1988 #117 Dave Sim Aardvark Comics 0712-7774
descriptionText:
Explore the intricate world of "Cerebus: Jaka's Story" with issue number 4, dated December 1988, a compelling addition to any comic book collection. Authored and illustrated by the renowned Dave Sim, this piece is a testament to his artistry and storytelling prowess, emanating from the revered publishing house of Aardvark-Vanaheim.

Immerse yourself in the unique narrative and distinctive artwork that has captivated fans for decades. Whether you're a long-time enthusiast or a newcomer to the series, this comic is a slice of the rich tapestry of US Comics tradition, showcasing the genre's depth and versatility.
